title: MAINT: add spec citation comment to PIV 7C/82 response parsing
description: The BER-TLV parsing block in wp11_piv_sign() (7C container → 82 response tag → signature bytes) has no comment citing NIST SP 800-73-4. A reader cannot verify correctness without knowing the response format. Fix: add above the parsing block: /* SP 800-73-4 Section 3.2.4, Table 13: GENERAL AUTHENTICATE response is\n   7C [len] 82 [siglen] [signature bytes] */. This is required for all APDU-level code per the project's test integrity rules (external oracle).
